notes: οἱ is unrepresented under rule 32's apposition clause, the expressed ὑμεῖς having already written the antecedent and the participle keeping the relativizer; a reference comparison will report that as a disagreement and it is not a correction.
The anarthrous θρόνου takes its supplied the as a helper (rule 51), while τῶν before ἀνθρώπου and τοῦ before Ἰσραήλ are unrepresented (rules 21, 23).
